name: sparsew2t data fetch (pump table, Binance Vision, CSRC, Baostock A-shares)
command: set -e; D=$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR; mkdir -p $D/pnd $D/crypto $D/csrc $D/ashare_bs; echo 0/5 > $D/progress.txt; curl -s -m 60 -o $D/pnd/pump_telegram.csv https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SystemsLab-Sapienza/pump-and-dump-dataset/master/pump_telegram.csv; python scripts/data_fetch/fetch_binance_pnd.py --pumps $D/pnd/pump_telegram.csv --out $D/crypto > $D/fetch_crypto.log 2>&1; echo 1/5 >> $D/progress.txt; python scripts/data_fetch/fetch_csrc.py --out $D/csrc > $D/fetch_csrc.log 2>&1; echo 2/5 >> $D/progress.txt; python scripts/data_fetch/fetch_ashare_bs.py --out $D/ashare_bs --procs 4 > $D/fetch_ashare.log 2>&1; echo 3/5 >> $D/progress.txt; python scripts/data_fetch/parse_csrc.py --decisions $D/csrc/csrc_decisions.jsonl --universe $D/ashare_bs/universe.csv --out $D/csrc > $D/parse_csrc.log 2>&1; python scripts/data_fetch/split_csrc_sheet.py $D/csrc/csrc_sheet_auto.csv 365 2008-03-01 >> $D/parse_csrc.log 2>&1; echo 4/5 >> $D/progress.txt; rm -rf $D/ashare_bs/cache; echo 5/5 >> $D/progress.txt; touch $D/DONE
